story_description: As a developer, I need the core onboarding infrastructure (state machine, navigation, persistence) so that subsequent onboarding screens can be built on a solid foundation with consistent navigation and state management.
task_description: Create the OnboardingViewModel with step-based state machine, navigation logic, and AppStorage persistence for tracking onboarding completion and user selections.
atom_description: Implement OnboardingStep enum defining all wizard steps, OnboardingViewModel @Observable class with step navigation, validation, and persistence, and OnboardingRootView container with step-based content switching.
problem_statement: The application needs a structured onboarding flow to guide first-time users through CLI detection, profile setup, and plugin/skill selection. Without core infrastructure, each screen would need to manage its own navigation and persistence, leading to inconsistent behavior and duplicated code.
scope_in: OnboardingStep enum with all seven wizard steps (welcome, userProfile, cliDetection, skillsRecommendations, pluginsRecommendations, agentsRecommendations, completion)
OnboardingViewModel @Observable class with currentStep state and navigation methods
Step validation logic via canProceedFromCurrentStep() method
Forward navigation via goToNextStep() with validation gate
Backward navigation via goToPreviousStep() without validation
Skip functionality via skipStep() for optional screens
Completion handler via completeOnboarding() that sets hasCompletedOnboarding flag
AppStorage persistence for hasCompletedOnboarding boolean flag
AppStorage persistence for userName and userEmail strings
AppStorage persistence for installedCLIs, selectedSkills, selectedPlugins, selectedAgents as JSON-encoded strings
OnboardingRootView container that switches content based on currentStep
OnboardingNavigationBar component with Back, Skip, and Next buttons
Progress indicator showing current step position (e.g., step 3 of 7)
scope_out: Individual screen implementations (WelcomeOnboardingView, UserProfileOnboardingView, etc.) - handled by O002-O007
CLI detection logic and process spawning - handled by O004-CLIDETECT
Plugin/skill/agent recommendation algorithms - handled by O005-O007
Network calls to fetch remote catalogs - handled by O005-O007
Theme customization for onboarding screens - uses existing theme system
Localization of onboarding strings - deferred to L10N epic
assumptions: AppStorage can persist Set types when JSON-encoded
The app launches to onboarding if hasCompletedOnboarding is false
Existing BlazeApp entry point can conditionally show OnboardingRootView vs main ContentView
constraints: Must use @Observable pattern consistent with existing codebase (SessionStore, EngineManager)
Must not block main thread during persistence operations
Navigation must be keyboard-accessible (Tab navigation, Enter to proceed)
State changes must be immediate with no perceptible lag
OnboardingStep raw values must be stable integers for persistence compatibility
functional_requirements: OnboardingStep enum defines exactly seven steps in fixed order: welcome(0), userProfile(1), cliDetection(2), skillsRecommendations(3), pluginsRecommendations(4), agentsRecommendations(5), completion(6)
OnboardingViewModel.currentStep initializes to .welcome on fresh install
OnboardingViewModel.goToNextStep() advances currentStep by 1 if canProceedFromCurrentStep() returns true
OnboardingViewModel.goToNextStep() does nothing if canProceedFromCurrentStep() returns false
OnboardingViewModel.goToPreviousStep() decrements currentStep by 1, minimum bound at .welcome
OnboardingViewModel.skipStep() advances to next step without validation (for optional screens)
OnboardingViewModel.canProceedFromCurrentStep() returns true for .userProfile step if userName is non-empty OR if user explicitly chose to skip
OnboardingViewModel.canProceedFromCurrentStep() returns true for .cliDetection step if at least one CLI is detected/installed
OnboardingViewModel.completeOnboarding() sets hasCompletedOnboarding to true and persists all selections
OnboardingRootView renders the appropriate screen view based on currentStep value
OnboardingNavigationBar shows Back button when currentStep is not .welcome
OnboardingNavigationBar shows Skip button for steps marked as skippable (.userProfile, .skillsRecommendations, .pluginsRecommendations, .agentsRecommendations)
OnboardingNavigationBar shows Next button with enabled/disabled state based on canProceedFromCurrentStep()
Progress indicator displays current step number and total steps count
nonfunctional_requirements: State transitions complete in under 16ms to maintain 60fps UI
Accessibility: VoiceOver announces step changes and button states

Implement Skip button with viewModel.skipStep() action
Implement Next button with viewModel.goToNextStep() action and disabled modifier

data_model_changes: Add OnboardingStep enum with Int raw value (0-6) for step identification
Add OnboardingViewModel @Observable class with published currentStep property
Add AppStorage key 'onboarding_installedCLIs' (String JSON array, default empty array)
Add AppStorage key 'onboarding_selectedSkills' (String JSON array, default empty array)
Add AppStorage key 'onboarding_selectedPlugins' (String JSON array, default empty array)
Add AppStorage key 'onboarding_selectedAgents' (String JSON array, default empty array)
api_contracts: OnboardingStep.allCases: [OnboardingStep] - returns all steps in order
OnboardingStep.title: String - localized title for step
OnboardingStep.subtitle: String - localized subtitle/description for step
OnboardingStep.isSkippable: Bool - whether Skip button should be shown
OnboardingStep.iconName: String - SF Symbol name for step indicator
OnboardingViewModel.currentStep: OnboardingStep - current wizard position
OnboardingViewModel.hasCompletedOnboarding: Bool - persisted completion flag
OnboardingViewModel.userName: String - user first name from profile step
OnboardingViewModel.userEmail: String - user email from profile step (optional)
OnboardingViewModel.installedCLIs: Set<String> - CLI identifiers detected/installed
OnboardingViewModel.selectedSkills: Set<String> - skill identifiers selected
OnboardingViewModel.selectedPlugins: Set<String> - plugin identifiers selected
OnboardingViewModel.selectedAgents: Set<String> - agent identifiers selected
OnboardingViewModel.canProceedFromCurrentStep() -> Bool - validation for current step
OnboardingViewModel.goToNextStep() - advance with validation
OnboardingViewModel.goToPreviousStep() - go back without validation
OnboardingViewModel.skipStep() - advance without validation
OnboardingViewModel.completeOnboarding() - finalize and set completion flag
OnboardingViewModel.progressFraction: Double - 0.0 to 1.0 progress for indicator
OnboardingViewModel.progressText: String - 'Step X of Y' display string
event_contracts: onboarding_started: Emitted when OnboardingRootView appears for first time
onboarding_step_changed: Emitted on currentStep change with { from_step: String, to_step: String, direction: 'forward' | 'backward' | 'skip' }
onboarding_step_validated: Emitted when canProceedFromCurrentStep() is called with { step: String, result: Bool, reason: String? }
onboarding_completed: Emitted when completeOnboarding() is called with { duration_seconds: Double, steps_skipped: [String], selections: { clis: Int, skills: Int, plugins: Int, agents: Int } }
onboarding_abandoned: Emitted if user quits app during onboarding with { last_step: String, duration_seconds: Double }
ui_states: Initial state: OnboardingRootView visible, currentStep = .welcome, progress shows 1 of 7
Mid-flow state: currentStep at any step 1-5, progress indicator updates, Back button visible
Validation blocked state: Next button disabled, tooltip shows validation reason
Skip available state: Skip button visible and enabled for skippable steps
Final step state: currentStep = .completion, Next button shows 'Get Started' label
Completed state: hasCompletedOnboarding = true, app shows main ContentView instead of OnboardingRootView
ui_interactions: User clicks Next button: triggers goToNextStep(), advances if validation passes
User clicks Back button: triggers goToPreviousStep(), returns to previous step
User clicks Skip button: triggers skipStep(), advances without validation
User presses Enter key: triggers Next button action (keyboard shortcut)
User presses Escape key: triggers Back button action (keyboard shortcut)
User presses Tab key: moves focus between navigation buttons
User quits app mid-flow: state persists, resumes at same step on next launch
User completes onboarding: transitions to main app, onboarding never shows again
ui_copy: Validation tooltip: 'Please complete required fields to continue'
edge_cases: User force-quits during onboarding: AppStorage persists currentStep, resumes on relaunch
User deletes app preferences: hasCompletedOnboarding resets to false, onboarding shows again
User on slow disk: AppStorage writes may queue, ensure no data loss on crash
User rapidly clicks Next: goToNextStep() is idempotent, multiple calls at same step are safe
User at .welcome clicks Back: goToPreviousStep() no-ops at minimum bound
User at .completion clicks Next: completeOnboarding() is idempotent, safe to call multiple times
User resizes window during onboarding: OnboardingRootView adapts with responsive layout
VoiceOver user navigates: all buttons have accessibility labels, step changes announced
failure_modes: AppStorage write fails (disk full): Log error, continue in-memory, retry on next interaction
JSON encoding fails for Set types: Fall back to empty set, log corruption warning
OnboardingStep rawValue out of bounds: Default to .welcome, log unexpected state
Memory pressure during onboarding: No large allocations, graceful under low memory
SwiftUI view crash: Wrap in error boundary (if available), show fallback UI
rollback_plan: Remove OnboardingRootView conditional from BlazeApp.swift, delete Blaze/Sources/Onboarding/ directory, remove OnboardingViewModelTests.swift. AppStorage keys will be orphaned but harmless. No database migrations to reverse.

acceptance_tests: Given a fresh install, when the app launches, then OnboardingRootView is displayed with Welcome screen
Given onboarding at Welcome, when user clicks Next, then UserProfile screen is displayed
Given onboarding at UserProfile with empty name, when user clicks Next, then navigation is blocked and tooltip appears
Given onboarding at UserProfile, when user clicks Skip, then CLIDetection screen is displayed
Given onboarding at any step after Welcome, when user clicks Back, then previous step is displayed
Given onboarding at Completion, when user clicks 'Get Started', then main ContentView is displayed and onboarding never shows again
Given app quit mid-onboarding, when app relaunches, then onboarding resumes at the same step
Given onboarding completed, when app relaunches, then main ContentView is displayed directly

completed_when: OnboardingRootView renders, navigation between all seven steps works correctly, state persists across app restart, and hasCompletedOnboarding flag transitions app to main ContentView.
completed_evidence: swift test --filter OnboardingViewModelTests shows all tests passing. Manual walkthrough from Welcome to Completion succeeds. App restart after completion shows ContentView directly.
status_reason: Infrastructure atom must be implemented first before any individual onboarding screens. Foundation for E005-F003 feature.
open_questions: Should OnboardingViewModel be a singleton or injected via environment?
Should we support resetting onboarding for testing via a hidden preference?
Should step validation errors show inline or in a toast notification?
notes: This atom establishes the foundation for the entire onboarding epic. All seven subsequent screen atoms (O002-O008) depend on this infrastructure. Design prioritizes simplicity and testability over flexibility.

Run 'swift test --filter OnboardingViewModelTests' and verify all 15+ tests pass
Launch app with fresh preferences (delete ~/Library/Preferences/com.cogit0.Blaze.plist) and verify onboarding appears
Walk through all seven steps manually, verifying navigation buttons and progress indicator

risks: AppStorage may not reliably persist Set types encoded as JSON strings
@Observable pattern may have edge cases with SwiftUI view updates
Step validation logic may need adjustment as screen requirements are finalized
Keyboard shortcuts may conflict with system or other app shortcuts
mitigations: Extensive unit tests for JSON encode/decode round-trip
Manual testing of view updates on step changes
Design validation as pluggable closures that screens can override
Test keyboard shortcuts in isolation and document any conflicts
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only Onboarding module and BlazeApp entry point. No impact on existing chat, settings, or engine functionality. Failure isolated to first-run experience.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If infrastructure has critical issues, fall back to simple conditional that skips onboarding entirely (set hasCompletedOnboarding default to true). Users can configure app manually via Settings.
